2607.02234.title: Purified OPSD: On-Policy Self-Distillation Without Losing How to Think
2607.02234.paper_summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) has emerged as a promising paradigm for improving LLM reasoning, where a privileged teacher with access to reference solutions provides token-level supervision on the student's own generated trajectories. However, we find that OPSD consistently fails on long chain-of-thought (long-CoT) reasoning models, yielding at best marginal gains while destabilizing the reflective reasoning capability these models depend on. Through a novel decomposition of the teacher's supervision signal, we identify the root cause: the teacher's supervision is dominated by a reference-induced component that drives rote memorization of reference-specific shortcuts, while the question-conditioned, inference-transferable component is ignored or actively opposed. Based on this diagnosis, we propose a two-step solution. First, we construct a reference-only teacher (the same model conditioned on the reference without the question) to isolate the non-transferable component of the supervision signal; the residual after subtracting this component captures the question-conditioned, inference-transferable correction. Second, we use pointwise mutual information (PMI) as the mechanism to transform this residual into a well-formed PMI target distribution that the student can directly distill from, filtering out the reference-induced shortcut. Experiments on four long-CoT models across two datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over both the base model and standard OPSD, while preserving the models' natural epistemic behavior throughout training.
2607.02234.paper_summary_zh: 在政策自蒸餾（OPSD）已成為改善大型語言模型（LLM）推理的有前景範式，其中一位擁有參考解答的特權教師對學生自己生成的軌跡提供逐字級的監督。<lb/>然而，我們發現OPS D在長鏈思考（long-CoT）推理模型上持續失敗，最多只能獲得微薄的增益，同時使這些模型依賴的反思推理能力不穩定。<lb/>通過對教師監督信號的新穎分解，我們識別出根本原因：教師的監督主要受到參考引起的成分主導，這驅動了對參考特定捷徑的死記硬背，而問題條件下的、可轉移的推理成分則被忽略或積極對立。<lb/>根據這一診斷，我們提出了一個兩步解決方案。<lb/>首先，我們構建了一個僅參考的教師（同一模型在沒有問題的情況下以參考為條件）以隔離監督信號的不可轉移成分；在減去這一成分後的殘差捕捉了問題條件下的、可轉移的修正。<lb/>其次，我們使用點對點互信息（PMI）作為機制，將這一殘差轉換為一個良好形成的PMI目標分佈，學生可以直接從中蒸餾，過濾掉參考引起的捷徑。<lb/>在兩個數據集上的四個長-CoT模型的實驗顯示，相較於基礎模型和標準OPSD，均有持續的改進，同時在整個訓練過程中保持模型的自然認識行為。
